product_overview: A React-based SISAD-PDFME demo application that lets users browse example routes and interact with designer, form, viewer, and schema catalog runtimes. The product also includes documentation-oriented tooling guidance for maintaining the repo’s script and markdown architecture.
core_goals: Browse the available example routes from a central catalog.
Open and use the designer runtime to arrange and edit schemas.
Fill out form templates and review the preview summary.
Inspect rendered documents in a read-only viewer.
Explore schema families and their example configurations.

features.name: Example catalog navigation
features.description: Let users browse the home catalog and open the main runtime and schema example routes.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Review the example catalog -> Open a runtime or schema example
Navigate to / -> Select a route card for a desired example -> Arrive at the chosen example page

features.name: Designer runtime
features.description: Allow users to work with the designer in single-user or multi-user mode and modify schema layouts.
user_flows: Navigate to /designer/single-user -> Open the designer runtime -> Move and edit schemas -> View the updated designer preview
Navigate to /designer/single-user -> Open the designer runtime -> Switch to /designer/multi-user -> Continue interacting in collaboration mode
Navigate to /designer/multi-user -> Open the multi-user designer runtime -> Move and edit schemas -> View the updated designer preview

features.name: Form runtime
features.description: Enable users to fill template fields, adjust repeated and choice-based inputs, and inspect the preview summary while navigating pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /runtime/form -> Open the form runtime -> Type into text inputs -> Change radios, checkboxes, selects, and repeatable fields -> Navigate pages -> Inspect the preview summary
Navigate to /runtime/form -> Open the form runtime -> Enter valid values into the template fields -> See the document preview update across the form

features.name: Viewer runtime
features.description: Let users review the rendered document in a read-only mode without making edits.
user_flows: Navigate to /runtime/viewer -> Open the viewer runtime -> Navigate pages -> Inspect rendered content without editing

features.name: Schema catalog
features.description: Help users explore schema families and open family-specific examples from the schema catalog.
user_flows: Navigate to /schemas -> Open the schemas catalog -> Browse schema families -> Navigate to a family-specific example
Navigate to /schemas -> Review available schema families -> Open a family example page
